'''''Caropsis''''' is a [[genus]] of [[flowering plant]]s in the family [[Apiaceae]]. Its only species is '''''Caropsis verticillatoinundata''''', [[native species|native]] to [[France]] and [[Portugal]].<ref name="POWO_893640-1">{{citation |title=''Caropsis'' (Rouy & E.G.Camus) Rauschert |work=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew|url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:893640-1 |access-date=2022-12-28 }}</ref>
